verdict.rationale: MoonPay's Web SDK documents a first-party method to delete a customer's stored payment method on request, which is a direct but narrow deletion control; clearing the browser connection on sign-out is closer to session handling than data deletion. Nothing covers retention policies or broader data deletion. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods, account/KYC data deletion or erasure requests, transaction-data deletion, data export, and any independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Use this method to remove a stored payment method — for example, when a customer asks to forget a card
Use this method to clear the customer's MoonPay connection in the current browser when they sign out of your app.
